name: Jaaku Leila
source: If Tina and Chris teach Leila wrong she becomes Malevolent type Leila. Malevolent Leila sees sex with her adoptive parents as a challenge of strength and eventually forces herself on them to prove her superiority. She has little love for her parents at all.
